Traffic Accident Map - Japan

This map displays traffic accident locations across Japan from 2019 to 2024 (approx. 1.9 million records), based on open data published by the National Police Agency (NPA). Pie charts visualize accident breakdown ratios for each area.

Click or tap on a pie chart to see accident statistics for that area. Zoom in further to view individual accident records.

  • Source: NPA Open Data (National Police Agency, Japan)
